'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Brian Herold DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel / Spice Mines Of Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
